rule CobaltStrike_Shellcode_Encrypted {
    meta:
        description = "Detects encrypted Cobalt Strike shellcode in memory via entropy and API patterns"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.004, T1059.001"
        weight = 95
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [4] E8 [4] 83 C4 0C } // common stack setup
        $b = { 8B D8 83 C3 ?? 8B C3 } // pointer arithmetic
        $c = { 83 EC ?? A1 [4] 85 C0 74 ?? 8B 08 } // indirect call resolution
    condition:
        uint32(@a + 7) > 1000 and
        filesize < 200KB and
        entropy(@a, 0x100) > 7.5 and
        all of ($a, $b, $c)
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded Cobalt Strike beacon configuration in memory or dump"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://github.com/rasta-mouse/ThreatCheck"
        hash = "e86f10ba1f3a2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 63 73 72 63 } // ".rcd.csrc"
        $b = "beacon" fullword ascii
        $c = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } [0-100] ("http" | "https")
    condition:
        all of them
}
